messages.text:
Hi Rory,

Our Pay Your Age campaign for Build-A-Bear produced queues stretching over a mile outside stores across Canada, the UK and the US, and lifted the brand's awareness score by 467 per cent in days. One story, no ad spend.

Earned press with numbers you can feel is the only kind of marketing we do.

Would you be interested in a conversation about the press angle for Helium Deploy heading into the holidays?

Kindly,
Elissa B.
Senior Client Manager

"Clarity comes from engagement, not thought." - Marie F.

If this isn't for you, please let me know - I will not reach out again.

Hi Elissa,

Thanks for reaching out, and for the Build-A-Bear example.

PR representation isn't something we're looking at right now, so I'll pass. I'd rather tell you straight than leave you chasing.

Appreciate the note, and good luck with the holiday campaigns.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
